title: Personal Essay Structure Explorer
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: See how the parts of a personal essay work together under three common structures, and plan your own essay with a 650-word budget.

learningObjectives: Students will plan a personal essay by choosing a structure and organizing its parts within a 650-word budget.

keyQuestions: Why does a narrative essay need a turn?
When would a montage serve a story better than a narrative arc?
Why is an essay under 500 words usually missing reflection?
commonMisconceptions: A personal essay should follow the five-paragraph format.
More story always makes a stronger essay.
assessmentOpportunities: Students produce an outline with a named structure, a job for each part, and a word budget between 550 and 650.
